settings.tabDescRooms: Rooms with location (Casablanca / Agadir), capacity, rates and amenities.
settings.tabDescTeam: Create accounts with one-time passwords, roles, deactivate staff.
settings.tabDescWorkingHours: Per-weekday open/close, closed days, slot increment and buffers.

settings.adminOnlyBody: The audit log records every change in the workspace. Only administrators can read it.
settings.generalSub: Business identity, contact details, timezone and currency — the single source of truth for invoices, emails and the public site.
settings.businessProfileDesc: Shown on emails, invoices and the login screen.
settings.localeNote: Users can override this per profile
settings.logoUnsupportedType: Unsupported file — use SVG, PNG or WebP.
settings.logoTooLarge: File is larger than 2MB — export a smaller version and try again.
settings.logoFormatsBefore: SVG, PNG or WebP · max 2MB — rendered via
settings.auditLogNote: Changes are written to the audit log
settings.logoFaviconNote: Logo also updates favicon, login and emails once live.
settings.roomsSub: Capacity, hourly rates and amenities per room. Deactivating hides a room from new bookings instantly.
settings.roomAvailabilityNote: True availability per room is coming with working-hours per room (v1.1).
settings.allRoomsDeactivatedBody: Nothing can be booked until at least one room is active. Reactivate a room below, or add a new one.
settings.roomNameRequired: Give the room a name first.
settings.roomRateMin: Hourly rate must be 0 or more.
settings.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Best before a formation day
settings.roomsAutoSave: Changes save automatically as you edit.
settings.roomsHqCount: {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} — HQ
settings.roomsSatelliteCount: {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} — satellite
settings.ratesVatNote: Hourly rates exclude VAT — invoices add 20% automatically.
settings.ratesSnapshotNote: Rate is snapshotted onto each booking — later price edits never rewrite history.
settings.ratesDeactivatedNote: Deactivated rooms below stay active in reports and exports.
settings.addRoomDesc: Available for booking as soon as it is added.
settings.categoriesSub: Booking categories shown across calendar, reports and filters. System entries can be renamed, never removed.
settings.displayOrderNote: Display order = order in booking pickers
settings.noCategoriesBody: Add your first category — bookings, filters and reports will pick it up immediately.
settings.categoryNameRequired: Give the category an English name first.
settings.howSystemCategories: System categories (Meeting Room Rental, Formation) can be renamed, never removed.
settings.howFormationType: Type Formation unlocks capacity, waitlist and price label on bookings.
settings.howOrder: Order set with the arrows is the order shown in booking pickers and filters.
settings.howDeactivate: Deactivating hides a category from new bookings — history keeps its label.
settings.brandTintsNote: Muted pastels from the brand book — WCAG-friendly at small sizes.
settings.addCategoryDesc: Appears instantly in booking pickers once saved.
settings.teamSub: The only place staff accounts are managed. One-time passwords are issued at creation and never shown again.
settings.rolesGateNote: Roles gate everything — Admin and Staff
settings.youCantDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account
settings.passwordsOneTimeNote: Passwords are one-time; you never see them again after close. Accounts are provisioned here only — Supabase Auth issues the sessions.
settings.accessAdmins: Admins create, edit, deactivate users and see audit logs.
settings.accessStaff: Staff manage bookings, clients and formations — nothing else.
settings.accessDeactivate: Deactivating revokes all sessions and signs the user out everywhere.
settings.accessFirstLogin: First login forces a password change — the one-time value is useless after.
settings.editUserDesc: Email is the login identifier and can't be changed here.
settings.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, e.g. name@eiden-group.com.
settings.accountExists: An account with this email already exists.
settings.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable — select the password and copy it manually.
settings.createUserDesc: The user gets a temporary password valid for first login only.
settings.copyPasswordDesc: Copy it now — it will never be shown again.
settings.tempPasswordShownOnce: Shown once — store it now. The user must change it at first login.
settings.workingHoursSub: When the business is open — the booking engine respects this for every new reservation, buffer included.
settings.mondayHoursApplied: Monday hours applied {scope} — save to persist
settings.copyMondayTitle: Copy Monday's hours to this day
settings.fixHighlightedRows: Fix the highlighted rows to save.
settings.openingBeforeClosing: Opening must be before closing — enforced per row.
settings.bookingRulesDesc: Applied to every new booking, everywhere.
settings.bufferNote: Setup & cleaning time before the next slot
settings.minNoticeNote: Last-minute bookings closer than this are blocked
settings.previewDesc: Bars render open hours between 07:00 and 21:00
settings.weekPreviewAria: Week preview chart — one bar per open day showing open hours
settings.slotSummary: Slot: {slot} min · buffer {buffer} min · notice {notice} h
settings.previewLiveNote: The grid updates live as you edit — the booking engine will never offer a slot outside these hours.
settings.notifSub: Which transactional emails go out — enforced on every send. Applies workspace-wide.
settings.notifBookingCreatedDesc: Client and team both get a confirmation email.
settings.notifBookingUpdatedDesc: Time, room or details changed — both sides are emailed.
settings.notifBookingCancelledDesc: Cancellation notice with reason and next steps.
settings.notifFormationReminderDesc: Sent 09:00 the day before a session — room, time, what to bring.
settings.notifChangeRequestReceivedDesc: Staff moved to resolve a conflict — admins are emailed.
settings.notifChangeRequestApprovedDesc: The requester gets the confirmed new slot in writing.
settings.notifChangeRequestDeclinedDesc: Polite decline with the admin's message attached.
settings.notifChangeRequestExpiredDesc: No decision before expiry — the requester is nudged automatically.
settings.notifWelcomeDesc: Sent once on user creation — includes first-login instructions.
settings.notifPrefsSaved: Preferences saved — applied to every send
settings.testEmailSent: Test email sent — check your inbox.
settings.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server — check your connection.
settings.weeklyDigestNote: Planned, not built yet — no Monday email goes out until v1.1 ships. Preview below is the working draft.
settings.testSendNote: Sent to your own account email — credentials never leave the server.
settings.whatsappSmsNote: WhatsApp and SMS go out once the provider is signed — same triggers.
settings.pushNotificationsNote: Push notifications pair with the v1.1 room-availability release.
settings.sendsLoggedNote: Every send is logged to the audit trail — open rates are not tracked, by policy.
settings.deliverabilityNote: Sends route through Hostinger SMTP (smtp.hostinger.com:587). Credentials live in Vercel environment variables — never in this page.
settings.categoryOffSilences: Turning a category off here only silences email — in-app notifications always show.
settings.weeklyDigestContentsDesc: Four sections, same order every Monday, rendered from live data once Supabase is connected.
settings.digestThisWeekSample: Salle Grande ×4 · Salle Formation ×2 · Salle Petite ×3 — grouped per room
settings.digestFormationsFillingSample: React Avancé — Session 4 · 19/20 seats · 1 on the waitlist
settings.digestChangeRequestsSample: 2 pending · oldest: ONCF steering — expires Thursday 00:00
settings.localizationSub: Language, hour and date formats, and how amounts render — for interfaces, emails and exports.
settings.defaultLocaleDesc: UI language, email copy and date wording. Users can override per-profile.
settings.profileOverrideNote: Users can override per-profile — change it on /profile.
settings.weekStartDesc: Calendar grid, week pickers and digest grouping.
settings.amountsMadDesc: Rendered live with Intl.NumberFormat — both locales side by side.
settings.liveSampleNote: Live sample · stored ledger is always MAD
settings.surfaceInvoices: Invoice PDFs — MAD amounts, 20% VAT, number format per locale.
settings.surfaceEmails: Booking emails — recipient's profile locale wins over the default.
settings.surfaceCsv: CSV exports — dates in the format selected above.
settings.surfacePublicSiteAfter: attribute and copy follow this setting.
settings.moroccoDefaultNote: Africa/Casablanca timezone and Monday week start are brand & payroll standards — set on /settings/general and locked here.
settings.currencyDisplayNote: Switching currency for display does not change stored amounts — MAD is the ledger currency.
settings.auditSub: Every write, who made it, and when — searchable, filterable, exportable. Admin-only by policy.
settings.clickRowHint: Click a row for request metadata
settings.noEntriesBody: Try wider dates, another actor, or clear the search.
settings.retainedNotePrefix: Retained 12 months, then purged nightly — change retention on
settings.retainedNoteSuffix: Exports include only the filtered view.
settings.everyMutationNote: Every mutation in this workspace is recorded here — exports and anonymizations included.
settings.dataPrivacySub: Export a full workspace snapshot, or anonymize a client on request. Every action here is logged.
settings.anonymizedBannerBody: was anonymized. Personal data is replaced with redaction markers — bookings and aggregates are unchanged.
settings.dangerZoneDesc: Irreversible actions. Both actions write to the audit log — export included. There is no un-anonymize.
settings.exportWorkspaceDesc: Full JSON snapshot — every workspace table except credentials, notifications and the audit log.
settings.exportDisabledNote: Export is disabled until Supabase is connected — no dump, no theatre.
settings.anonymizeDisabledNote: Anonymization is disabled until Supabase is connected — no fake deletes.
settings.clientAnonymizedToast: Client anonymized — logged to the audit trail
settings.anonymizeClientDesc: GDPR-style erasure on request — name, contacts and notes are replaced with redaction markers. Bookings stay for reporting.
settings.retentionNotificationsValue: Kept until cleared — purge job at launch
settings.retentionNote: Retention runs as a nightly job once live — see docs/RUNBOOK.md, backups & restore.
settings.ledgerFooterNote: Anonymization is written to the audit log. Bookings and aggregates stay for reporting — contacts are redacted on every future render.
settings.beforeExportSnapshot: The snapshot covers every workspace table except credentials, notifications and the audit log.
settings.beforeExportCredentials: It never contains credentials, tokens or SMTP keys.
settings.beforeExportClientSide: Stored client-side in your download folder — we don’t keep a copy.
settings.anonymizeReplaces: Replaces name, email, phone, address and notes with redaction markers.
settings.anonymizeKeeps: Keeps bookings, invoices and aggregates — reporting stays intact.
settings.anonymizeIrreversible: Irreversible — there is no “un-anonymize”, by design.
settings.erasureRequestNote: A signed erasure request must arrive at makrich@eiden-group.com before any real anonymization happens.
settings.anonymizeConfirmDesc: Type the client's exact name to confirm — this cannot be undone.
settings.searchClientsPlaceholder: Search clients by name, company, email…
settings.irreversibleUnderstood: I understand this is irreversible and the data cannot be recovered.
settings.mailSub: How CALENDAR. talks to the connected mailbox — status and one-click connection tests.
settings.mailTestUnavailable: Mail test unavailable — set .env then redeploy (or ask your admin)
settings.mailboxVisibleTitle: Mailbox address is visible to admins only
settings.credNoteBefore: Credentials live in Vercel environment variables — never in the database or the browser. See
settings.howItWorksStep1: Keys live in Vercel env vars — SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD — scoped per environment.
settings.howItWorksStep2: A server-only route reads them on demand and opens a real connection to Hostinger.
settings.howItWorksStep3: The result — verified or the exact failure code — is rendered right here. No guessing.
settings.testFailsRoute: Route missing → .env not set on this environment — set it and redeploy.
settings.testFailsAuth: Auth fails → rotate SMTP_PASSWORD in Vercel, then redeploy.
settings.testFailsUnreachable: Unreachable → Hostinger IP allow-list or port 587 blocked outbound.
